summary: Backend + frontend E2E tests for the college/non-college restructure passed cleanly. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_sourapple_v2.py covering tracking-number formats (MV-/UC-DORM-LASTNAME-MMDDYYYY, non-college LASTNAME-MMDDYYYY), Dry Cleaning removed from SERVICE_TYPES, multi-service order creation & pricing (58.0 verified), /payments/methods returns cashapp=$lvcenterprise / venmo=@lvcenterprise / stripe_enabled=true, /payments/manual sets Pending Confirmation, /payments/stripe/checkout returns real Stripe URL (checkout.stripe.com) using the LIVE key without completing a charge, in-app messaging round-trip works for student & admin with 403/404 role enforcement, confirm-pickup posts system message & flips pickup_confirmed, request-change/cancel work in Pending & 400 after job started, admin schedule clears change_request, admin calendar excludes Pending/Rejected/Cancelled, admin alerts returns pending+changes counts, new statuses 'Ready for Pickup' and 'Cancelled' accepted. Frontend E2E (mobile 390x844): student login → Schedule → College Student + Utica University + dorm 'Boehlert' + directions → services (Dry Cleaning is confirmed ABSENT from chip list) → 07/20/2026 + Morning → Submit → tracking screen renders 'UC-BOEHLERT-STUDENT-07202026' with NO QR image, Messages chat sends+persists, Request Change + Cancel Order buttons visible; payment/confirm-pickup buttons correctly hidden while status='Pending Admin Approval' (design-gated). Admin login → Requests screen with alerts-banner ('10 new request(s)'), admin-order rows navigate to detail showing Customer (Utica University · Boehlert · Directions), Set Times card (sched-pickup/sched-deldate/sched-deltime), Messages chat, and Approve button. Calendar tab visible in bottom bar. No React Native red screens; only console warning is 'shadow* style props deprecated — use boxShadow' (RN Web deprecation, cosmetic).

issues: Services chip toggle: if 'Wash & Fold' is pre-selected by default, tapping it toggles OFF — testers can miss this. Consider visually distinguishing default vs currently-selected state, or clear default so user actively picks.

Payment buttons (Stripe/CashApp/Venmo) and Confirm Pickup are gated on order.status !== 'Pending Admin Approval' / status==='Ready for Pickup'. That is correct design, but consider adding an inline note like 'Payment options unlock once we approve your request' so customers aren't confused when they see 'Unpaid' without any pay button.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with the newer boxShadow prop for react-native-web 0.19+.

action_items: (Optional UX) Add helper text on the order tracking screen when payment_status is Unpaid + status is Pending Admin Approval so customers know payment unlocks after approval.
(Optional UX) On Schedule, either clear default service selection or brand the pre-selected chip so users don't accidentally deselect it while trying to pick multi-service.
(Cosmetic) Migrate any StyleSheet entries using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to the boxShadow prop (react-native-web deprecation warning).
(Cosmetic) server.py at 903 lines is now over the 700-line guideline — consider splitting into routers/{auth,orders,admin,driver,payments,messaging,ai}.py.
(Cosmetic) FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 903 lines. Split by concern to stay under the 700 line guideline.
release_job() still has dead-code `pass` branch (lines 463-466) — either enforce state check or remove.
/admin/jobs/{id}/assign still overloads StatusUpdate.status to carry driver_id — misleading; dedicated AssignBody would be clearer.
stripe.checkout.Session.create is synchronous — called inside async endpoint. Works but blocks the event loop on network I/O; consider run_in_executor or stripe async client.

tracking_number() uses last token of user['name'] as last name. Seeded student is 'Jamie Student' so LASTNAME becomes 'STUDENT' — safe here but if a customer registers with just a first name it becomes 'CUSTOMER'. Consider a dedicated last_name field on the user profile.
_can_access() returns True when order is None because 'not (…)' short-circuits — safe here because the caller re-checks `not order`, but the helper alone is misleading; make it explicit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login all roles, student college order submit + tracking + chat, admin requests + alerts banner + order detail with schedule/messages/approve, calendar tab visible)

seed_data_creation: Tests created ~5 TEST_-prefixed orders under seeded student@sourapple.com (fresh pending orders + one advanced to Picked Up + one Cancelled). Second TEST_other_* student created per session for 403/404 checks. No manual DB seed needed — server.py seeds admin/student/driver on startup.
